description_en: Modifies the visibility mode of the BI portal menu and whether the menu is only authorized to be visible
description_zh: 修改数据门户菜单的可见方式，是否仅授权可见
name: ChangeVisibilityModel

parameters.description_en: The ID of the BI portal.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the BI portal
parameters.name: data_portal_id

parameters.description_en:
The menu ID of the BI portal leaf node.

*   The directory menu cannot be authorized.
*   You can upload multiple parameters at a time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). The maximum number of parameters that can be modified at a time is 100.
parameters.description_zh:
数据门户的叶子节点菜单ID。

- 支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为100

parameters.name: menu_ids

parameters.description_en:
Whether only authorization is visible. Valid values:

*   true: Only the authorization is visible.
*   false: Both are visible.
parameters.description_zh:
是否仅授权可见。取值范围：

- true：仅授权可见
- false：都可见
